name: Türkiye
unit: Filtered fire detections (VIIRS where available, otherwise MODIS); not harmonized
filters: Detections flagged as static sources or offshore, and low-confidence detections, are removed; for recent near-real-time data a location mask built from archived static sources is used.
acknowledgment: We acknowledge the use of data and/or imagery from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) (https://earthdata.nasa.gov/firms), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
